decision_log.rationale:
All three pipeline stages completed successfully with no replanning required.

**Ingestor (✅ passed):** Accepted 128,369 / 177,310 GEDI shots (72.4% acceptance rate) using sensitivity_min=0.90 and slope_max_deg=30°. Shot density of 13.36/km² is well above minimum thresholds. Sentinel-2 coverage is solid with 142 scenes and moderate 20.4% cloud cover, fully masked via SCL bands.

**Transformer (✅ passed):** All 5,000 shots matched to Sentinel-2 bands with a 0.0% NaN rate. Spatial autocorrelation range resolved at ~35.6 km; CV block size set to 28.75 km across 5 folds (12 occupied blocks). Fold distribution is acceptable for spatial cross-validation.

**QA (✅ passed):** All 15 expected feature columns present with 0.0% NaN across all 8 S2 bands and indices (B2, B3, B4, B8, B11, B12, NDVI, EVI). Fold balance is healthy (13.9%–29.4% per fold, all above the 5% floor). rh98 target range is [2.31m, 68.26m] with a mean of 14.24m — physically plausible with no impossible or null values flagged.

The cleaned dataset is ready for downstream canopy height model training.
